name: Australia

name: France

name: Germany
note: Germany, including Waffen-SS and Luftwaffe ground formations (folder germany). The unit id prefix is GER; the nationality value is Germany; the adjective used in names is German.

name: Italy
note: Italian formations of the Kingdom of Italy (folder italy). Added 15 November 2026 with the nation_allegiance table. **Split between IT and RSI (15 November 2026; a convention for Scott to confirm):** IT is the King's forces, that is the Regio Esercito, Regia Marina and Regia Aeronautica up to the armistice of 8 September 1943 (Axis, then neutral gap) and the co-belligerent forces of the Kingdom from 13 October 1943; RSI is the forces of the Italian Social Republic proclaimed on 23 September 1943 (its republican army, navy, air force and party and police formations). A formation that exists on both sides of the split keeps its IT record up to 8 September 1943 and an RSI re-formation gets its own RSI record with a lineage link, as with other redesignations (no source of the dataset names one yet). The dated sides are in data/nation_allegiance.csv. No unit yet.

name: Norway
note: Norwegian formations (folder norway). Added 15 November 2026 for the Normandy air and naval pass (331 and 332 Squadrons; Norwegian-flag ships); no unit yet.

name: New Zealand
note: New Zealand formations (folder new_zealand). Added 15 November 2026 for the Normandy air and naval pass (RNZAF squadrons such as 485; no unit yet). The adjective is the country name as written in the sources.

name: Poland
note: Polish formations serving under British or Allied command (folder poland).

name: Italian Social Republic
note: Formations of the Italian Social Republic (Repubblica Sociale Italiana), the German-backed state in northern Italy proclaimed on 23 September 1943 (folder italian_social_republic). Added 15 November 2026. Its units are not the King's: see the split between IT and RSI in the note of IT. The adjective `RSI` is used in unit names. No unit yet.

name: South Africa
note: South African formations (folder south_africa). Added 15 November 2026 for the Normandy air and naval pass (SAAF and South African Naval Forces; no unit yet).

name: UK
note: United Kingdom and Commonwealth formations serving in British armies except those with their own entry (folder uk).
